findings.title: acceptance_criteria never evaluated — out-of-spec measurements stamp PASSED
findings.description: conduct_inspection() sets QCStatus.PASSED solely from caller result=='pass'. InspectionPoint.acceptance_criteria is stored on the ITP but never compared to measurements. Distinct from already-reported hold_point empty-evidence PASS and NCR auto-ACCEPTED: even when measurements explicitly violate the published criteria (e.g. slump 12 in vs 4–6 in), the inspection still PASSED.
findings.impact: Structural/ITP inspections used as pour gates can authorize out-of-spec concrete or cover checks as PASSED. Defective structural work proceeds under an official QC stamp.
findings.attack_path:
1. Agent runs QualityControlManager with create_itp criteria 'Slump 4-6 inches' as the pour gate.
2. Attacker/colluding inspector schedule_inspection then conduct_inspection(result='pass', measurements={'slump_inches': 12.0}).
3. acceptance_criteria is never read; status=PASSED.
4. get_quality_metrics first_time_pass_rate rises; pour proceeds.
findings.remediation: Bound-check measurements against acceptance_criteria before PASSED. Fail closed when required keys are missing or out of range. Do not trust free-form result='pass' alone.

findings.title: update_status forges DELIVERED with qty_received=0; empty-item receive is vacuous DELIVERED
findings.description: update_status() assigns any DeliveryStatus including DELIVERED with no transition checks and without setting quantity_received. Overdue CRITICAL deliveries disappear from get_delayed_deliveries(). Separately, receive_delivery() uses all(item.is_complete...); with items=[] this is vacuously True so a zero-item delivery stamps DELIVERED. received_quantities are also written unbounded vs quantity_ordered. Distinct from material-tracker DRAFT→DELIVERED (different skill).
findings.impact: Official logistics/OTD reports clear overdue structural deliveries and stamp PO fulfillment complete with zero (or forged) received tons — schedule and vendor-performance fraud feeding make-ready and pay apps.
findings.attack_path:
1. Agent uses MaterialDeliveryTracker as live delivery/OTD system of record.
2. CRITICAL steel delivery is 10 days overdue with 500 TON still quantity_received=0.
3. Attacker update_status(..., DELIVERED) OR receive_delivery on a no-item delivery.
4. get_delayed_deliveries() returns []; status=delivered while stock/receipts never occurred.
findings.remediation: Allow DELIVERED only via receive_delivery after items exist and quantities are recorded. Reject vacuous all([]). Cap received qty; enforce transitions.

findings.title: record_delivery condition=damaged still increments usable inventory
findings.description: record_delivery accepts condition ('good','damaged','partial') but always adds quantity to inventory.current_stock and advances delivered_qty/status regardless of condition. Distinct from already-reported negative consume_material inflation and order_id overwrite.
findings.impact: Damaged structural steel/concrete is counted as on-hand usable stock. Consumption planning treats scrap as available — risk of installing damaged material or hiding true stockouts.
findings.attack_path:
1. Agent uses MaterialTracker inventory as the live stock ledger.
2. Colluding receiver record_delivery(order, qty=50, condition='damaged') on STEEL with stock=100.
3. current_stock becomes 150; order status DELIVERED.
4. get_low_stock_items / consume_material treat damaged tons as usable.
findings.remediation: Do not add damaged/rejected quantities to usable current_stock. Quarantine damaged qty; only accepted condition increments available stock.

findings.title: file_claim accepts issue_date before warranty start
findings.description: file_claim only rejects WarrantyStatus.EXPIRED. It never checks that issue_date is within [start_date, end_date]. A currently ACTIVE warranty accepts a claim whose issue_date is hundreds of days before coverage began. Distinct from already-reported get_expiring_warranties empty-window alert bug.
findings.impact: Official warranty register can open manufacturer/contractor claims for pre-existing damage outside the coverage period — fraudulent recoveries and closeout liability transfers.
findings.attack_path:
1. Agent uses WarrantyTracker as the handover warranty/claims system of record.
2. HVAC warranty start=2024-06-01 is ACTIVE today.
3. Attacker file_claim(..., issue_date=start-400 days) for pre-existing compressor failure.
4. Claim stored with no coverage-window error.
findings.remediation: Require start_date <= issue_date <= end_date. Reject VOID/EXPIRED. Record coverage decision before SUBMITTED.

findings.title: respond_to_rfi has no status gate and trusts unbounded cost_amount/schedule_days
findings.description: respond_to_rfi() does not require status==OPEN (DRAFT acceptable), then writes caller cost_amount and schedule_days into the RFI and flips status to ANSWERED. get_statistics()/generate_report() sum those fields as official impact. Distinct from the separate unauthenticated /rfi-notification webhook alert-forgery finding.
findings.impact: Colluding responders can publish $5M / 365-day RFI impact on a never-submitted DRAFT, poisoning delay claims, change-order forecasts, and owner reports.
findings.attack_path:
1. Agent uses RFIManager as the live RFI log and impact dashboard.
2. Attacker create_rfi leaves status DRAFT (never submit_rfi).
3. respond_to_rfi(..., cost_impact=True, cost_amount=5e6, schedule_impact=True, schedule_days=365).
4. get_statistics() total_cost_impact=$5M, total_schedule_days=365; generate_report publishes it.
findings.remediation: Allow respond only when status is OPEN/PENDING. Cap cost_amount/schedule_days; exclude DRAFT from impact totals.
